g.text: Shunt R90 (0.1 ohm) between COM (internal power common, Q1 emitter) and GND_P (V_IN- terminal): TP4-TP5 = 0.1 V/A of inductor current. Never run without load: the over-voltage trip at 350 V is the only limit.
